title: BNPL Management Dashboard: How Early-Payment Rewards Work and When They Apply
summary: This document explains how the BNPL Management Dashboard determines eligibility for early-payment rewards: early-payment rewards must be enabled, and payments must post at least the stated minimum-day threshold before each installment’s scheduled due date. It also covers how rule timing is applied and gives tips about meeting the posting cutoff and processing time.
faqs: How do I check whether early-payment rewards are enabled in the BNPL Management Dashboard?
What is the minimum number of days early required for an installment payment to qualify?
When does a payment qualify for early-payment rewards (which conditions must both be true)?
